name: hayate
description: HAYATE: a 58-second anime short rendered entirely by code (three.js), Fable 5.5 Anime Lab.

scripts.encode: node tools/draft_qc.mjs --frames final/frames --ext png --outdir final --name video_noaudio.mp4 --qa final_ --crf 19 --maxrate 26M --bufsize 52M --preset slow && node tools/master.mjs --ceiling -2.2 --out final/hayate.mp4
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render && npm run player && npm run encode
